name: Baby Finger Toothbrush - Children's Silicon Finger Transparent Toothbrush
description:
Silicone Baby Finger Brush. 
Brand new and high quality. 
It is a great way for parents to ensure oral hygiene for their babies. 
Massage gums and promote the development of teeth, support a child's hygiene habits from an early age. 
Food-grade silicone material, soft, protective mouth, clean simple, 
not hidden dirt, health and safety, non-toxic, more peace of mind. 
Perfect for soothing baby’s teething gums by giving them a gentle massage. 
Essential travel anywhere, anytime clean mouth.
